tonight.headline: Up 46.7 with every starter final — Bok-aneers have only Kraft and Lloyd left, on 5.6 projected
body: Bad news first: Tyler Allgeier finished with 5.8 on 18 carries while Bam Knight ran 15 times for 80 and, by NBC's read, outplayed him; Alvin Kamara's 14.9 sat on your bench. Josh Allen finished 18.3 against a 25.5 projection in a 33-30 win. Jordan Love has 17.0 on the bench tonight.

Nothing to do. Every AVIATO starter is final at 122.6. Bok-aneers have Tucker Kraft (2.9) and MarShawn Lloyd (-0.2) still playing in Green Bay and project to finish near 87.7. ESPN: 99%. This would be AVIATO's second win.

case.label: Why nothing
case.body: Every starter has played. McLaurin (Monday) is on the bench behind final starters and cannot move in until Week 7 opens.

case.label: The Allgeier result
case.body: 18 carries and 2 targets for 5.8 (live archive, final); Knight 15 carries for 80 and two catches (NBC Sports 19 Oct 00:33Z). The lineup call over Kamara lost by 9.1 and closes WRONG in the decision log. Knight 'possibly got hurt', per the same item — no detail yet.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Kraft and Lloyd adding about 47 between them tonight — nine times what ESPN has left for them. Nothing you can act on either way.

case.label: The bye
case.body: Buffalo's bye is Week 7 (ESPN file), and so are Jacksonville's (Tuten), Washington's (McLaurin) and the Chargers'. Love's Green Bay bye is Week 11. Love was added on 15 Oct for exactly this week.

case.label: Checked tonight
case.body: Love is playing Dallas now, 17.0 so far, and no Packers injury has been reported (NBC Packers inactives 18 Oct 22:54Z; NFL.com Sunday injuries). Allen finished healthy in Las Vegas (Yahoo 18 Oct).

case.label: The rest of Week 7
case.body: Jefferson and Gordon return from byes. Tuten's running-back slot goes to whoever Tuesday's Week 7 projection prefers among Allgeier, Kamara and Gordon — and Bam Knight out-gained Allgeier today (NBC 19 Oct), so that is a real question, not a formality.

case.label: Not an override
case.body: A bye is a zero. This is a forced move, not a read of Love against Allen.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love is hurt tonight or ruled out for Week 7 (then a free-agent quarterback, not Love), or Week 7 projections put a free quarterback more than two points above him and the swap is made anyway.
